title: Reunion of Siblings
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji gripped the broken transmission jade slip tightly, his knuckles white. Within three months, he would personally raze the Holy Sect to the ground—and before that, he had to become stronger.

text.content: Deep within the secret realm, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burned hot, emanating an eerie golden-red glow. Chen Ji's footsteps halted as his spiritual sense was violently pulled into a vision by an invisible force. The surroundings shattered and reformed like broken glass, and when he opened his eyes again, he found himself standing on a dark altar. The air was thick with the scent of blood, twelve pitch-black stone pillars encircled him, each etched densely with countless prohibition runes that glowed with a chilling phosphorescence. At the center of the altar, a slender figure hung suspended in mid-air by nine chains, like a lamb prepared for sacrifice.

Her emaciated form barely held together, her thin garments stained with blood, her disheveled black hair concealing most of her face. Yet the familiar contours, the outline that remained recognizable despite such torment, seized Chen Ji's heart with an invisible grip, nearly stopping his breath. "Nian'er..." he choked out, his voice raw, his throat feeling like it was filled with shattered glass. The name he had buried in the deepest corner of his memory, the person he had sworn an entire lifetime to seek, now stood before him in such a cruel manner.

The voice was as delicate as a silken thread, yet it exploded in Chen Ji's ears like thunder. He lifted his head sharply, meeting eyes bloodshot yet still clear—gaze lacking hatred, lacking fear, only boundless worry, as if saying: You shouldn't have come here. The tear tracks at the corners of her eyes, the slightly upturned lips, she was actually smiling. "They... will activate the self-destruction prohibition..." Chen Nian's every word seemed to exhaust her entire body's strength, fragmented yet crystal clear, "You shouldn't... have come..."

Chen Ji's entire body stiffened, his fists clenched until they crackled. He wanted to rush forward, to shatter those wretched chains, to pull his sister from this living hell. Yet the moment he took his first step, all nine chains erupted with blinding radiance, unleashing a catastrophic prohibition force that consumed the entire altar. The runes squirmed like living entities, threatening to trigger a self-destruction capable of reducing a hundred-li radius to scorched earth.

A clear tear traced down Chen Nian's cheek, yet she persisted in sustaining that heart-wrenching smile. She knew that once the self-destruction prohibition activated, not only would her brother perish, but every living being within the secret realm and hundreds of miles would turn to ash. Her existence's purpose was to serve as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," sealing away some secret that should never be glimpsed for those lofty existences—a secret that even the Eyes of Heavenly Way would regard with caution. "Tianji Record... complete version..." With her final ounce of strength, she channeled information through the spiritual bond connecting brother and sister, "Seventh layer... only the seventh layer... Brother, live..."

The vision began warping, Chen Nian's form flickering like a candle in the wind. Chen Ji desperately reached out, but his fingertips only grazed emptiness. He watched helplessly as his sister's features blurred, those eyes that had endured so much suffering slowly closing. For three years he had orchestrated the world, his calculations flawless, believing he controlled everything within his grasp. Yet now, confronting this insurmountable despair, his self-assured composure completely shattered. "No—!" His scream echoed through the distorted space, futile and mournful.

Just as the vision was about to vanish completely, Chen Ji finally perceived the complete form of those prohibition runes—not an ordinary seal, but an ultimate forbidden lock forged with living souls as sacrificial offerings and blood relatives' obsession as the catalyst. Those ancient monsters of the Holy Sect intended to use Chen Nian's soul to eternally suppress the secret capable of threatening the Heavenly Way. Rescuing her would trigger the self-destruction; abandoning her meant she would remain trapped forever, suffering worse than death. This was a deliberate scheme, a deadly trap, the cruelest mockery of his reputation for meticulous planning.

dialogue.content: "Does the strength of an ant presume to challenge destiny?"

text.content: A sound beyond human capability echoed from the depths of the Void, carrying the indifferent tone of surveying insignificant creatures. Chen Ji's hair stood on end—the voice had no physical form, yet he felt a soul-deep suppression, an existence transcending all comprehension, a will that viewed the ancient heavens as merely a chessboard. The Eyes of Heavenly Way. It watched, observed this self-proclaimed world-strategist like a mere fool. All his scheming, calculations, and machinations were nothing more than childish games before those无形 eyes. Terror surged through him like a tide, yet he forcibly suppressed it within an instant. "I will remember," he murmured, his voice terrifyingly calm. "Today's board... I, Chen Ji... will have my vengeance."

The vision shattered completely, and Chen Ji snapped back to consciousness in the secret realm's depths, the Tianji Record Fragment in his grip dissolving into ash. An intense sting shot through his palm—a backlash from overusing his spiritual sense within the vision. Cold sweat had already soaked through his inner robes, his knees slightly trembling, but he rigidly stabilized himself through sheer willpower. The vision had been overwhelmingly real, so vivid that he could almost smell the blood from the altar and sense the despair and tenderness in his sister's words. Three months. He had only three months remaining.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stood alone in the secret realm's ruins, his mind replaying his sister's warnings and those indifferent Heavenly Eyes. Now he faced a critical decision—

choices.text: Rush into the Holy Sect regardless of consequences
choices.description: Act immediately, even at the cost of his life, to rescue his sister from torment as quickly as possible. Even if the self-destruction prohibition meant mutual destruction, it was better than letting her continue being tortured.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may trigger self-destruction prohibition
choices.risk_hint: Survival uncertain, success or failure hangs on this single move

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, turning to flee toward the Holy Sect. However, the moment he activated his spiritual energy, a sharp pain shot through his body—the spiritual impact from the vision had disrupted his meridians. Forcing his lightness skill would be suicidal. He had to halt, furiously striking the stone wall beside him, blood seeping through his clenched knuckles. Impulsiveness would only result in his own death and his sister's.

choices.text: Plan carefully and grow stronger first
choices.description: Rushing in recklessly would only result in a meaningless death. I must first find the complete version of the Tianji Record, seek opportunities to break through my current realm, and strategically plan my way out within three months.
choices.visible_cost: My sister must endure suffering for another three months
choices.visible_reward: More thorough preparation leads to greater chances of success
choices.risk_hint: Time is tight, testing patience and wisdom.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcing himself to calm down. His sister's words still echoed in his ears—"Seventh Layer"—that was where the complete Tianji Record lay. If he could obtain the complete Heavenly Secrets power, perhaps he could find a way to break the self-destruct formation. He opened his eyes, the grief in them replaced by icy light. "Three months." he murmured, "Nian, wait for me three more months."

choices.description: Relying on his own strength alone would be difficult to shake the Holy Sect's foundation. He must unite with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and even Han Lie, to have a chance of victory.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's own strength and weaknesses.
choices.visible_reward: Gain powerful assistance, share the risks.
choices.risk_hint: Allies may betray, information may leak.

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then retrieved two communication jade talismans from his sleeve. For Su Qingyao's talisman, he hesitated briefly before finally inscribing a few terse words: "Important matters to discuss, concerning my life." For Ye Qing's, he chose a more cryptic message—"The chess game is about to change, are you willing to enter the board?" He mentioned nothing about his sister; that was his final weakness, something no one could know. But he needed helpers, needed allies who could fight side by side. This Holy Sect game, he couldn't play alone.

At the secret realm's exit, a blue figure waited anxiously. Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. When she saw Chen Ji stumble out, her expression changed dramatically. "What happened to you?" She rushed forward in three swift steps, reaching out to support him, only to be dodged by a sidestep. In that instant, she clearly saw the tumultuous hatred and... vulnerability hidden deep in his eyes. "Chen Ji, what exactly happened?" Her voice softened involuntarily. This person she had always considered worthless was, at this moment, inexplicably heart-wrenching.

dialogue.content: "Nothing." Chen Ji's voice returned to its usualplain, as if that moment of losing composure had merely been an illusion, "It's just that some things need to be replanned."

text.content: He raised his head toward the horizon, his eyes reflecting the countless stars above, yet the corner of his mouth curved into an unfamiliar arc for Su Qingyao. It was neither mockery nor self-mockery, but a kind of近乎crazed的determined. "Three months." he said, "Within three months, I will make the Holy Sect pay a price they can never imagine." Before the words even faded, he had already walked away, leaving only a solitary, upright silhouette. Su Qingyao stood frozen in place, overwhelmed by inexplicable emotions—she realized for the first time that this person called atrash might never have been simple from the start.

Night fell. Chen Ji sat alone in the temporarily opened cave dwelling. Before him lay the Tianji Record Fragment spread open, the characters on it writhing like living things, yet never able to form a complete chapter. His sister's voice still echoed in his ears, "Seventh Layer"—that meant there were deeper areas of the secret realm yet to explore. He closed his eyes, beginning to deduce each subsequent move in his mind. Holy Sect, Eye of Heavenly Mandate, self-destruct formation... these seemingly unsolvable deadly traps gradually took shape in his exceptionally sharp mind. "Mister Mo." he suddenly spoke, "Do you know where the entrance to the Seventh Layer is?"

dialogue.content: "What's the rush?" The aged and distant voice emerged from the fragment, carrying a meaningful tone, "You haven't even set foot in the Third Layer, yet you want to covet the Seventh? However..." The voice paused, as if contemplating something, "What you witnessed today was rather unexpected to this old one. That girl's life is harder than you imagine."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a flash of brilliant light in his pupils. He did not ask why Mister Mo knew about his sister—this soul fragment guardian never proactively revealed things he was unwilling to say. He merely deeply suppressed that urgency in his heart, rose, and walked toward the stone wall carved with runes deep within the cave dwelling. His fingers gently brushed across those grooves, a familiar sensation surging forth—this was the entrance to the second layer of the secret realm. Three months' time was enough for him to breakthrough the remaining five layers, to obtain the complete Tianji Record. And by then, he would see how long those old monsters of the Holy Sect could continue to be arrogant.

Outside the cave, moonlight shone like water. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his black hair fluttering in the night wind. Around him, golden-red light faintly circulated—that was the Tianji Record Fragment's power slowly merging with his divine consciousness. Pain and burning intertwined, yet he swallowed them hard. He thought of the oath he made when leaving Chen Family Village three years ago, of his sister's silhouette being snatched away amid flames, of her eyes full of blood stains yet still gentle in last night's vision. "Nian." he murmured, "Brother swears, I will definitely come to save you." Three months—he repeated this deadline, as if establishing a military order for himself. From now on, there would be no moretrash Chen Ji in this world, only Chen Ji who would go to any lengths to save his closest kin. Holy Sect, three months later, let's settle this blood debt properly.
